### Button

The action button, in four variants and three sizes. ButtonLink renders a router link that looks the same.

```ts
import { Button, ButtonLink } from '@/kit/components/ui/Button'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'ghost' \| 'plain' \| 'danger'` | `'primary'` | Visual style. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Height and padding. |
| `arrow` | `boolean` |  | Adds the trailing arrow used by call-to-action buttons. |
| `block` | `boolean` |  | Stretches to the full width of its container. |
| `icon` | `boolean` |  | Square, icon-only button. Give it an `aria-label`. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  | Shows a spinner and disables the button (Button only). |
| `to` *(required)* | `string` |  | Destination for ButtonLink (react-router). |

```tsx
<Button arrow>Open an account</Button>
<Button variant="ghost" size="sm" loading={saving}>Save</Button>
<ButtonLink to="/pricing" variant="plain">See pricing</ButtonLink>
```

- Accepts every native `<button>` attribute; ButtonLink accepts every router `Link` prop.
- Disabled and loading buttons ignore clicks.

### Tag

A small uppercase label for status or category.

```ts
import { Tag } from '@/kit/components/ui/Badge'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'accent' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'error'` | `'neutral'` | Color of the tag. |
| `children` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | Label. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<Tag tone="success">Gain</Tag>
```

### Chip

A pill with an optional colored initial. With `onClick` it becomes a toggle button.

```ts
import { Chip } from '@/kit/components/ui/Badge'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | Label. |
| `mark` | `string` |  | Letter shown in a colored square before the label. |
| `markColor` | `string` | `'var(--accent)'` | Any CSS color for the mark. |
| `pressed` | `boolean` |  | Pressed state when used as a toggle. |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  | Makes the chip a button. |

```tsx
<Chip mark="S" pressed={showBenchmark} onClick={() => setShowBenchmark((v) => !v)}>S&P 500</Chip>
```

- Renders `aria-pressed` when it is a button.

### Badge

A bordered pill with an optional icon, for short facts such as "Read-only access".

```ts
import { Badge } from '@/kit/components/ui/Badge'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Icon before the text. |
| `children` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | Text. |

```tsx
<Badge icon={<ShieldCheck />}>Read-only access</Badge>
```

### Delta

A signed percentage colored green, red or grey. Uses the locale from the theme config.

```ts
import { Delta } from '@/kit/components/ui/Badge'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` *(required)* | `number` |  | The change, in percent units (2.4 means +2.40%). |
| `digits` | `number` | `2` | Decimal places. |
| `format` | `(n: number) => string` |  | Custom text, for example a rank movement. |

```tsx
<Delta value={2.41} />   // +2.41%
```

- A value of 0 shows "—" in grey.

### Dot, Eyebrow, Kbd

Three tiny pieces: a status dot, the mono uppercase label above headings, and a keyboard key.

```ts
import { Dot, Eyebrow, Kbd } from '@/kit/components/ui/Badge'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'success' \| 'warning' \| 'error'` | `'success'` | Dot color. |

```tsx
<Eyebrow>Pricing</Eyebrow>
<span><Dot tone="warning" /> Unsaved</span>
<Kbd>⌘K</Kbd>
```

### Card, CardHead, Kpi

The raised surface, its header row, and a labelled figure for dashboards.

```ts
import { Card, CardHead, Kpi } from '@/kit/components/ui/Card'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `flush` | `boolean` |  | Card: removes padding so tables or charts can touch the edges. |
| `label` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | Kpi: small caption above the value. |
| `value` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | Kpi: the big figure. |
| `sub` | `ReactNode` |  | Kpi: line under the value. |

```tsx
<Card><Kpi label="Net worth" value="$152,528" sub={<Delta value={2.5} />} /></Card>
```

### Alert

An inline message in four tones.

```ts
import { Alert } from '@/kit/components/ui/Feedback'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'error'` | `'info'` | Color and icon. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` |  | Bold first line. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | Body text. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Buttons shown on the right. |

```tsx
<Alert tone="warning" title="Reconnect needed">Your bank asks you to renew consent.</Alert>
```

- Error alerts use `role="alert"`; the others use `role="status"`.

### Meter

A thin progress bar.

```ts
import { Meter } from '@/kit/components/ui/Feedback'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` *(required)* | `number` |  | Current value. |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | Upper bound. |
| `tone` | `'success' \| 'warning' \| 'error'` |  | Bar color; accent when omitted. |
| `label` *(required)* | `string` |  | Accessible name. |

```tsx
<Meter value={68} label="Savings goal" />
```

- Renders `role="progressbar"` with the value attributes.

### Skeleton

A shimmering placeholder block shown while content loads.

```ts
import { Skeleton } from '@/kit/components/ui/Feedback'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | `string \| number` | `'100%'` | CSS width. |
| `height` | `string \| number` | `'1em'` | CSS height. |
| `radius` | `string \| number` |  | Corner radius. |

```tsx
<Skeleton height="1.25rem" width="60%" />
```

- Hidden from assistive technology.

### EmptyState

A centered message for lists and tables with nothing to show.

```ts
import { EmptyState } from '@/kit/components/ui/Feedback'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Icon in a soft square. |
| `title` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | Heading. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | Explanation. |
| `action` | `ReactNode` |  | A button below the text. |

```tsx
<EmptyState title="No transactions yet" action={<Button size="sm">Link an account</Button>}>Link a bank to see spending here.</EmptyState>
```

### Avatar, AvatarGroup

A round (or square) user picture. Without an image it shows initials on a color derived from the name.

```ts
import { Avatar, AvatarGroup } from '@/kit/components/ui/Avatar'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` *(required)* | `string` |  | Full name; used for initials, color and the accessible label. |
| `src` | `string \| null` |  | Image URL. |
| `size` | `number` | `32` | Diameter in px. |
| `square` | `boolean` |  | Rounded square instead of a circle. |
| `names` *(required)* | `string[]` |  | AvatarGroup: the people to stack. |

```tsx
<Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" size={40} />
<AvatarGroup names={['Ada Lovelace', 'Grace Hopper']} />
```

### Terminal, CopyButton

A dark code block with one row per command and a copy button.

```ts
import { Terminal, CopyButton } from '@/kit/components/ui/Terminal'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `head` | `string` |  | Small uppercase title above the rows. |
| `rows` *(required)* | `{ label?: string; code: string; shell?: boolean }[]` |  | Commands. `shell` prefixes a green "$". |
| `text` *(required)* | `string` |  | CopyButton: the text copied. |

```tsx
<Terminal head="Install" rows={[{ label: 'npm', code: 'npm install @acme/client', shell: true }]} />
```

- The copy button falls back to a hidden textarea where the Clipboard API is unavailable.

### Section, SectionHead, PageHero

Page scaffolding: a bordered section in the content column, its heading block, and the large page title block.

```ts
import { Section, SectionHead, PageHero } from '@/kit/components/ui/Section'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `eyebrow` | `ReactNode` |  | Mono uppercase label above the title. |
| `title` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | Heading. |
| `lead` | `ReactNode` |  | Paragraph under the heading. |
| `center` | `boolean` |  | SectionHead: centers the block. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | PageHero: buttons under the lead. |

```tsx
<Section><SectionHead eyebrow="Charts" title="Draws without a spinner" lead="Hover to read any day." /></Section>
```

### Reveal

Fades its content up when it scrolls into view.

```ts
import { Reveal } from '@/kit/components/ui/Reveal'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `as` | `ElementType` | `'div'` | Element to render. |
| `index` | `number` | `0` | Position in a group; each step adds 60 ms of delay. |

```tsx
<Reveal index={1} className="card">…</Reveal>
```

- Does nothing visible when the visitor prefers reduced motion.

### AssetIcon

A rounded letter tile in one of the chart colors, picked from the text.

```ts
import { AssetIcon } from '@/kit/components/ui/AssetIcon'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `symbol` *(required)* | `string` |  | Text whose first letter is shown. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes (for size). |

```tsx

```
